defects.claim: PDF image crops with out-of-bounds source rectangles leave that part of the destination blank instead of clamping to edge texels
defects.scenario: Two-pixel opaque image drawn with a source rect starting at x=-1, two pixels wide; renderer paints the whole destination, PDF leaves the negative-x part blank; also atlas sprites with out-of-range source rects
defects.cause: finite bitmap placed in destination clip without edge extension

defects.claim: Gradients with transparent stops change hue in PDF because the color ramp is interpolated straight rather than premultiplied
defects.scenario: RGB gradient from opaque red to transparent blue; renderer stays red through the fade, PDF shows purple at half opacity at the midpoint
defects.cause: straight DeviceRGB ramp instead of premultiplied interpolation
